policy: Research candidates are quarantined from runtime. Promotion requires a reviewable current source proving exact composition, canonical Base IDs, explicit Datacron scope, current-version validity, provenance, copyright-safe paraphrase, and a source-supported execution sequence. Aggregate win statistics alone do not satisfy execution requirements.
reason: No reviewed 5v5 candidate currently satisfies every promotion requirement. Runtime execution therefore remains source-gated rather than invented.
